items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (high ankle sprain) downgraded to OUT vs Bengals; Tyler Huntley starts again.
items.why: High ankle sprain confirmed; missed prior two games.
items.implication: Huntley start; Ravens offense downgrade, Bengals D upgrade potential.

items.text: Eagles WR DeVonta Smith ruled OUT for MNF vs Cowboys (along with Dontayvion Wicks).
items.implication: AJ Brown/others target bump; Saquon still expected.
items.opportunity: Increased targets to remaining Eagles pass-catchers.
items.conflict: Berry had loved DeVonta pre-OUT for volume.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford targets hierarchy: Higbee, Mumpfield, Parkinson, Atwell, Whittington, Allen. Nacua GTD, will test pregame; felt lack of power/explosion.
items.why: Calf injury; limited/missed practices; McVay notes minor but will test pregame.
items.implication: Major DFS/slate pivot if OUT; TE/WR2+ elevation.
items.opportunity: Higbee lead target if Puka inactive amid Adams also OUT.

items.text: Packers activated RB Josh Jacobs from exempt; expected to play Sunday.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs post-layoff workload questions.

items.text: Activated/expected: Christian Kirk (49ers debut), Tank Dell (Texans return), Jordan Mason (Vikings), Josh Jacobs, Jonah Coleman.
items.opportunity: Kirk in depleted 49ers WR room; Dell upside.

items.text: OUT: David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Davante Adams, Rashee Rice, Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Tyler Warren, Zach Charbonnet, Jeremiyah Love, Brian Robinson.
items.implication: Handcuff/backup and teammate bumps (e.g. Judkins IN, etc.).

items.text: Saquon Barkley expected to return Week 7 vs Cowboys (Q but expected); if active, right back in lineups. Efficient in prior full games; DAL soft vs RBs.
items.why: Returning from hamstring; expected per reports; matchup juice.

items.text: Brian Robinson (hamstring) OUT. 49ers D inflating opp RB by 4.4% (7th-most); recent RB receptions high. Sweet full-workload setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.why: BRob OUT; SF DvP soft vs RBs recently (White, Holani, Harvey, Love catches).
items.implication: Bijan bellcow + receiving upside vs soft matchup.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/carries/routes for Bijan; pace may be slow but volume secure.

items.text: 49ers entire WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT, others); Kittle will go nuts on scheme + opportunity. Tempted by CMC more slot work amid WR injuries (rare buy on RB-as-WR).
items.why: Evans/Deebo OUT; Kirk activated but WR dire; CMC smiled at slot question.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to Kittle/CMC; National TE Day narrative secondary.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK with Caleb: 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/g, 6+ rec and 60+ yards in both games since return.
items.why: Elite target share and production with Williams.

items.text: The more I watch Jaylen Warren, the more I love his game. Steelers have something special. Loved as RB9 @ NO for workload + matchup.
items.why: Big workload in friendly matchup; NO carved by RBs.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% of snaps over last three weeks. Downgrade.
Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet injury may reduce 2-/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
Hates Rome Odunze vs NE (shadow by Gonzalez, outside targets) and Travis Kelce @ SEA (tough matchup); also Josh Downs target share issues.
